own pointer-fragment correlator and its own connected correlator, the threshold indicator |c_i| >= 0.5 is evaluated separately per fragment, and every crossing event in the ledger is tagged with the fragment index that crossed.
per_mode: checked and not executed — no spectral or normal-mode decomposition is formed anywhere in this runner. The single-branch Kraus operators are diagonal in Z, so the recurrence closes exactly on a fixed Pauli-Z observable set (pointer polarization, per-fragment polarization, and their correlator); there is no diagonalizing mode basis to introduce and none is used.
per_block: checked — the outcome tree is resolved in two labelled blocks that are tracked separately on every branch. The phase-1 label records the three pointer-to-fragment broadcast measurements and the phase-2 label records the subsequent 10 pointer-only steps, and the direct and recurrence constructions are required to agree branch by branch on both labels, not merely on aggregate counts.
lattice_wide: checked and executed only at fixed register size — R-bar is a genuine whole-register aggregate, summing over all branches the branch weight times the number of fragment sites above threshold. It is bounded evidence: the register is fixed at 4 qubits, the depth at 10 phase-2 steps and the coupling at eps in (0.6, 0.9). No large-register or asymptotic limit is taken, so the absent single-ratio envelope is a checked-table statement and not a proof of nonexistence.
